description: Checking for and installing an update. Its own file, not part of the default capability, because a Microsoft Store build does not have the updater plugin compiled in at all — and a capability naming a permission that does not exist is a build error, not a warning. tauri.store.conf.json selects the capability set without this one. The permission is check-and-install only: the endpoint and the public key every update is verified against are fixed in tauri.conf.json and cannot be chosen by the WebView.
